Reine Rorbuer is looking for a certified kayak guide for a 50% position during the busiest part of the summer season.

What we offer:

• 

Work in the heart of Reine

• 

Spend your working days outdoors on the fjord

• 

Meet guests from all over the world

• 

Join a small, friendly and supportive team

• 

Possibility to work more than 50% by combining kayak guiding with shifts in other departments, depending on your experience and our operational needs

We can assist with accommodation during the employment period

• 

is a certified kayak guide with sea kayaking experience

• 

has a full driving licence

• 

speaks fluent English

• 

is fit, reliable and comfortable working outdoors in changing weather

• 

is service-minded and good with people

• 

is available for the full period 15 June -- 15 August 2027

Hospitality experience, Scandinavian languages, photography are an advantage.

Send your CV and a short introduction to blaz@reinerorbuer.no, including information about your kayak qualifications and previous guiding experience.

At Reine Rorbuer resort, our guided kayak tours, hikes, photo tours and Northern Lights tours help guests experience the extraordinary landscape of Lofoten. Based in the fishing village of Reine, where the mountains meet the Arctic Ocean, we aim to make every activity as memorable for its warm, attentive service as for its setting.

We hold our activities to a high standard, and our guided kayak tours have earned a high guest satisfaction score. We're looking for people who take pride in that standard and are committed to giving every activity guest an outstanding experience.

jobs.occupation: CLEANING SUPERVISOR  HOSTEL
jobs.description:
CLEANING SUPERVISOR – HOSTEL
Stockholm, Sweden
We are looking for a hands-on Cleaning Supervisor to join our growing hostel group in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone with strong cleaning experience who is organized, responsible and enjoys working with people in an international environment.
Who we are looking for
Previous experience in professional cleaning and preferably as a cleaning supervisor or team leader.

Strong cleaning skills and a good understanding of cleanliness and hygiene standards.

Able to communicate confidently in English, both spoken and written.

Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.

Comfortable supervising and coordinating a small team.

Positive, practical and willing to take initiative.

EU citizenship or permanent residency/work authorization in an EU country.

Experience in hospitality, hostels or hotels is a plus, as is education within hospitality or service.

You do not need extensive hospitality or management experience to be considered. If you have strong cleaning experience, the right attitude and are willing to learn, we are happy to train you in the other parts of the role.
The role
As Cleaning Supervisor, you will both work hands-on with cleaning and supervise a small team. Your responsibilities include:
Cleaning guest rooms, bathrooms and common areas.

Supervising and coordinating the cleaning team.

Checking rooms and common areas to ensure our cleanliness standards are maintained.

Planning and distributing daily cleaning tasks.

Keeping track of cleaning supplies, linen and other necessities.

Helping with hostel reception and guest-related tasks when needed.

Reporting maintenance issues and helping solve practical day-to-day problems.

Communicating with the hostel management, online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel’s operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. You will have flexibility to organize your schedule according to the needs of the property.
About us
We are a growing hospitality company currently operating three hostels in central Stockholm. Our goal is to build an international hostel group based around our Scandinavian Nomad design concept.
Our organization combines on-site teams with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are opportunities to grow within the company and take on more responsibility over time.
What we offer
Salary: 27,000 SEK/month gross
Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included
Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel
Vacation: One month paid vacation per year
You will work in a friendly, international environment, meet people from around the world and have the opportunity to develop your English, hospitality and leadership skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.

jobs.occupation: Beauty, Wellness or Physiotherapy Professional  - Norway
jobs.description:
Lotus Clinic has been established for 18 years and is located inside Hotell Frøya on the island of Frøya in Trøndelag, Norway.
Over the years, we have built a large and loyal client base, and we experience strong demand for our treatments from both local residents and hotel guests.
Our clinic shares premises with a Barber Shop, creating a friendly and active environment for clients and professionals.

Our current services include:
.Massage
.Beauty and facial treatments
.Foot care
.Waxing
.Lash lifts
.Eyelash and eyebrow treatments

We are now looking for a new colleague who can strengthen our team and potentially expand the range of treatments we offer.

Who are we looking for?
We welcome applications from qualified and experienced professionals within one or more of the following areas:
.Physiotherapy
.Massage therapy
.Beauty therapy / skincare
.Foot care
.Spa and wellness therapy
.Nail design / nail technology

Experience or qualifications in several types of treatments would be an advantage, but are not required.
We are also very interested in candidates who can bring new skills or treatments to the clinic.

About you
We are looking for someone who:
.Is professional, reliable and service-minded
.Enjoys working with people
.Takes pride in providing high-quality treatments and excellent customer service
.Is comfortable working independently
.Also enjoys being part of a friendly and professional working environment
.Is flexible regarding working hours
.Is interested in developing a long-term professional relationship with the clinic

For physiotherapists, the necessary qualifications and authorisation required to practise as a physiotherapist in Norway must be obtained.

Language
You must be able to communicate well with clients and colleagues.
Knowledge of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is an advantage, but we also welcome applications from candidates from other European countries.
Good English skills may be sufficient when starting the position, depending on your professional field and responsibilities.
A willingness to learn Norwegian over time would be an advantage.

Moving to Frøya, Norway
We warmly welcome applications from candidates living outside Norway.
For the right candidate, we can assist with finding suitable accommodation on Frøya and provide practical information to help with relocation and settling into the local community.
Frøya is located on the Trøndelag coast and offers a unique combination of professional opportunities, an active local community and beautiful coastal nature.
For someone considering a new chapter in Norway, this is an opportunity to join an established business where you do not have to start from scratch - Lotus Clinic already has an existing client base and strong demand for treatments.

How to apply
Please send us your CV and a short application in English or Norwegian.

Tell us about:
.Your education and professional qualifications
.Your work experience
.The treatments and services you can provide
.Any additional skills you could bring to Lotus Clinic
.Why you would like to work and live on Frøya

Applications will be considered on an ongoing basis.
We look forward to hearing from you - and hopefully welcoming you as our new colleague at Lotus Clinic in beautiful Frøya, Norway!

Clinical work with a strong emphasis on endoscopy

Willingness to learn Swedish
